The renewal application must be submitted through AIUB web portal by Thursday, 17 September 26 . The renewal process and the detail guideline are now available in the AIUB portal. item.description: Winter University in Engineering Sciences 2026 – Exchange Program Director of the Russian House in Bangladesh announces Winter University in Engineering Sciences 2026, an international academic program to be held in Russia from 23 November to 6 December 2026. The program is open to 3rd–4th year bachelor’s students studying engineering-related disciplines at foreign universities. For selected participants, the organizers will cover round-trip travel, accommodation, meals, and excursions included in the program. Participation in the program is free of charge. The application deadline is 4 October 2026, and selected participants are required to attend the program in person. Applications should be submitted directly through the official platform: https://winteruniversity.ru/en

item.title: Survey for Free Online Courses through AIUB's Collaboration with Saylor University
item.description: The American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB) is pleased to announce its collaboration with Saylor University, a pioneering U.S.-based nonprofit institution dedicated to expanding access to quality higher education through free online learning opportunities. Saylor University offers more than 150 university-level online courses that are freely accessible and self-paced, covering a wide range of disciplines, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Science, Business, Leadership, Computer Science, Marketing, Project Management, and English as a Second Language (ESL). Saylor is recognized on the United Nations Academic Impact platform and collaborates with educational institutions and organizations worldwide to promote accessible and affordable education. As part of this collaboration, AIUB students and members of the AIUB community will have the opportunity to access Saylor courses free of charge through a dedicated AIUB-Saylor learning portal that is currently under development. Before finalizing the customized course portal and registration process, AIUB and Saylor University would like to understand the learning interests and preferences of the AIUB community. Therefore, we invite interested students, faculty members, and staff to submit their areas of interest through the Expression of Interest Form below. Please note that this is not the final course registration process. The information collected will be used to identify the most in-demand courses and subject areas, enabling AIUB and Saylor University to tailor the collaboration and learning opportunities to the needs of the AIUB community. Important Information: This form is intended only for collecting initial expressions of interest. Course registration will begin at a later stage after the dedicated AIUB-Saylor portal is finalized. item.title: AIUB Announces Prestigious 4+1 Accelerated U.S. Master’s Pathway with Florida International University
item.description: The American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB) is pleased to announce a new international academic collaboration with Florida International University (FIU), USA, introducing a 4+1 Accelerated Bachelor–Master’s Degree Program through FIU’s Chaplin School of Hospitality & Tourism Management. This specially tailored pathway enables eligible AIUB undergraduate students, particularly from BBA programs, to begin a U.S. Master of Science in Hospitality Management while completing their Bachelor degree at AIUB, allowing them to save both time and cost while gaining global exposure. Students may complete up to 12 graduate credits from FIU during their final year at AIUB, with these courses counting toward both degrees, and then transition to FIU to complete the remaining credits either online or in person in Miami. The program is offered at a highly subsidized total tuition of approximately USD 19,800, with scholarships and incentives that reduce overall costs by more than USD 15,000 compared to traditional study pathways. Eligible students must have completed 75–90 credits with a minimum GPA of 3.2 and apply in their senior year with academic approval from AIUB. Those opting for the in-person track in Miami will benefit from U.S. work permit eligibility, internship opportunities, and direct exposure to the global hospitality industry. This initiative reflects AIUB’s continued commitment to internationalization, industry relevance, and expanding global academic opportunities for its students. Interested students are encouraged to contact Dr. Partha Prasad Chowdhury ( partha.p@aiub.edu ) or Mr. Stanley Rodrick ( stanley@aiub.edu ) for application details.

The use of AIUB’s name, logo, or any other official signage in any activity, program, or organization—whether inside or outside the university—without prior permission from the authority is strictly prohibited. item.title: Re-instating Health and Safety Measures in AIUB Campus
item.description: REF: AIUB/REG/Covid-19 Health & Safety/Jun 2025 Date: 17 June 2025 NOTICE Re-instating Covid-19 Health and Safety Measures in AIUB Campus 1. Due to the recent increase in COVID-19 cases, the University is implementing following health and safety measures to protect our campus community: a. Wearing a face mask is mandatory inside campus premises. b. Practice respiratory etiquette including coughing and sneezing into bent elbows, prompt disposal of tissues in the trash (if used) and avoid spitting in public places. c. Wash hands thoroughly and frequently, especially before and after coming into frequent contact with high touch point surfaces like door handles, bannisters, elevator buttons, equipment, etc. d. While inside campus, if any student feels ill, and particularly with COVID-19 type symptoms of cough, fever, shortness of breath, runny nose, or sore throat, or any of the other symptoms must contact the department head/ director/ course teachers immediately. e. If anyone requires medical support, please report to the medical Center. 2. Effective immediately these measures will apply to all students and accompanying persons/guests (as applicable) entering the campus regardless of their vaccination status. 3. Your commitment, compliance and understanding to maintain a safe and healthy campus environment is appreciated. Respectfully, Gp Capt (Retd) Dr. Mohammad Zahidul Islam Khan, acsc, psc Registrar, American International University-Bangladesh

Pool interior, premises and patio should not be littered with food wrappers or any other trash. People with open cuts, wounds, bandages, injuries, cold, cough, fever, skin disease, venereal disease and upset stomach are not allowed to swim. No pushing, shoving, horseplay or inappropriate behavior is allowed. Swimming Pool users must bring their own Swimming gear, towel and water bottle. Food and drinks are not allowed in the aquatic facility, except for water in unbreakable containers. Spitting, spouting water from the nose and mouth are prohibited. Non-swimmers are only allowed under the direction of a swimming instructor. Photo Shoots/ making videos are not allowed in the pool area. item.title: Event Day Important Guidelines of 22nd Convocation ceremony (Saturday, 22 February 2025)
item.description: Vehicle Movement: Vehicle Movement will be controlled on the day of the Convocation Ceremony (Saturday, 22 February 2025) from the entrance of Kuratuli Road. Vehicles with registered ‘car parking permit’ will be only allowed to proceed to the campus. The ‘car parking permit’ must be displayed on the car. Elderly guardians/ guests are advised to use the entrance through Bashundhara since it may be difficult to walk through the Kuratuli road due to excess traffic. Car Parking: Due to limitations of space, on-campus Parking will be available only for registered cars carrying the ‘Car Parking Permit’. The permit must be displayed on the car during the ceremony. Graduating Students and Guests: Avoid bringing kids. Arrival Time: 8.00 AM. There will be restrictions in entry after 9.30 AM. Students must be seated in the designated area according to seat plan by 10.00 AM. No entry to the seating area after 10.00 AM. Students and guests should stand up during National Anthem (at the beginning and at the end of the program). When the Registrar declares the name of the faculties during conferring their degree (at 10.50 AM in the program schedule), students of the respective faculties should stand up when their faculty name is called. Follow the instructions of the Registrar about moving the tassel of the cap. Awardees: If you are an award recipient in any category as finalized and printed in the convocation souvenir, please check your name in the souvenir book and prepare accordingly. Vice Chancellor’s Awards (For the best thesis, internship reports, projects, teaching practicum, etc.) and Leadership Awards: After the speech of Convocation Speaker (around 11.12 AM), recipients of Vice Chancellor’s Awards and Leadership Awards must report to the OSA representatives at the right side of the stage and be on a queue to be called on the stage. item.description: Online Final Registration Guidelines for Probation Students SPRING 2024-2025 Probation students can apply online for Final registration according to the Final registration schedule. As a probation student, you are unable to confirm final registration without the probation department's consent. Apply first for Final Registration from your portal. Follow the following steps: Step 1 : Log in to AIUB Portal (https://portal.aiub.edu) for online final registration. Step 2: Click on the “Go to Registration” button. Step 3: Click on the “Apply here” button, you must wait for the approval of the probation department Step 4: You must wait for the probation department's clearance if the application was submitted successfully Step 5: The “next” button will appear if your application is accepted. Go and meet your respected advisors to confirm the Final Registration Step 5: If your application is denied, you will see instructions from the Office of Probation and follow the instructions accordingly.
